rows.mutation: skip the nonce check
rows.reason: The nonce check is an early exit. The key has already changed, so a replay still fails on its key or its signature, at full cost.

rows.mutation: skip the balance check
rows.reason: Clarity aborts the transaction when the debit underflows, so nothing is paid. The check turns that abort into a named error.

rows.mutation: allow a withdrawal of nothing
rows.reason: A signed withdrawal of nothing only rotates the key. The transfer of zero then fails, so today nothing happens at all.

rows.mutation: allow the current key as the next key
caughtBy: a one-time key is still in place after it signed

rows.mutation: skip the next key's length check
rows.reason: A short next key would lock the vault, which hurts only its owner. No verifier accepts a key that is not 32 bytes.

rows.mutation: keep the old key after a withdrawal
caughtBy: a one-time key is still in place after it signed

rows.mutation: leave the chain out of the digest
rows.reason: Simnet is one chain. A testnet signature replayed on mainnet cannot be tried here.

rows.mutation: leave the nonce out of the digest
rows.reason: Each withdrawal already signs under a new key. The nonce in the digest only matters if an owner reuses a key.
